blocks.text:
## Trip highlights

São Luís is the city stop on this route, with a historic centre, old façades, markets, churches and an Atlantic coastline. You can add a separate four-hour city tour.

Barreirinhas is the starting point for the dunes of Lençóis Maranhenses. From March to September, rainwater forms blue lagoons between the dunes. We take you by 4x4 to Lagoa Azul, where you can swim and watch the sun set.

The next day you travel along the Preguiças River. You'll see Vassouras, known as Little Lençóis, a fishing village and a lighthouse reached by 160 steps.
